features.crystalGlass: Layered optical glass gradients, bright meniscus highlights and inset refraction; no backdrop-filter.

features.springPhysics: v37: GPU-composited transform/opacity spring curves drive press, dock glide and screen/sheet morphs at 60-120fps
features.lowEnd: v37: single hardware video overlay, sleeping canvas, contain:layout style and transform-only transitions keep low-end phones smooth
features.instantResponse: v37: 0.04s press recognition, 0.16s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) spring release, 0.22s screen and sheet glide, GPU transform/opacity only, a 60ms debounced DB.save() and a canvas that ignores UI taps

features.creditSpotlight: Top-centred cinema entrance and eight-second disappearing/reappearing cycle, with player-header clearance.
features.englishDefault: English (lang "en", guideLang "en") remains the default, with an optional Sinhala switch inside the User Guide.
features.humanVoice: One single unified Cambridge British woman studio voice (en-GB) for every word, number, countdown, helper and instruction.
features.sessionFlow: Ready instruction, visual and spoken countdown, number + word, 650ms pause, same word again, five-second writing timer.
features.cleanWords: v49: TTS.cleanWordOnly strips bilingual slashes (tyre/tire -> tyre) so only the clean target reaches the single unified voice endpoint.
features.repeatReplay: Repeat replays the current number and word, then repeats the same word after 650 ms; a second tap on Slower replays the loaded stream at 0 KB with playbackRate 0.72.
features.noDeviceVoice: The device speechSynthesis engine is only a safety net when the stream cannot start; it is locked to a British female voice.
features.voiceLifecycle: Starting, pausing, replaying, navigating or leaving cancels the audio element, the synth utterance and every timer.
features.testSound: Sound check streams the real Youdao studio audio without a debug pill.
features.numberedWords: v49: Pass 1 says Number N and the clean word in one en-GB Youdao stream; after a 650 ms studio pause Pass 2 replays the same element at 0 KB, then the 5 second writing timer runs.
features.pauseResume: v49: pause and resume prompts use the direct Youdao stream; timers freeze and the current word restarts cleanly.
features.finishSummary: v49: the completion summary uses the direct Youdao stream and preserves paper/type result behaviour.
features.tts: Direct https://dict.youdao.com/dictvoice?type=1&audio= stream assigned to #ttsMasterAudio (no fetch, no Blob, no Cache API, no CORS), 0 KB currentTime replay, pinned British female speechSynthesis fallback after 1600 ms.
features.voice: One unified Cambridge British woman studio voice (en-GB) from the Youdao dictionary stream; the Sinhala guide uses the locked si-LK speechSynthesis fallback.
features.fallback: Every English line streams from Youdao; if the URL errors, is blocked or misses the 1600 ms start window the pinned en-GB British female speechSynthesis voice speaks instead.
features.dictationNumber: One Dictation #N progress label plus progress dots; duplicate word-card badges are removed.
features.bundledAudio: Removed: no generated or bundled MP3 pack; no synthetic formant, waveform or espeak audio.
features.countdown: Three, two and one each remain visible at least 500ms; the next cue waits for the prior recording to finish.
features.voiceFallback: Any <audio> error, play() rejection or a 1600 ms start timeout hands the same text to the pinned British female speechSynthesis voice, so the app is never silent.
features.guideAudio: First-run opens the guide silently; explicitly opening Guide plays narration, with language, replay and stop controls.
features.helpers: Repeat, slower, masked sentence and spelling reset the timer and resume it after playback.

features.zeroWaste: No boot prefetch at all; Pass 2 and Slower replay the already loaded #ttsMasterAudio at 0 KB.
